listing.name: Hypershroud 2.0
listing.summary: Gives Hyperspace a bold new look, turning it into a deep, hungry crimson by default. If you’re feeling adventurous, you can swap it out for one of several alternate realities: Pink Delirium, Luddic Verdance, Cyan [REDACTED], Violet Warpstorm, and a secret fifth hue you’ll have to discover for yourself. Just move your chosen color set into the main graphics directory to shift the tone of the void.
listing.aiSummary: Changes the appearance of hyperspace travel to a crimson hue by default, with options for other colors.

description: Reskins the hyperspace environment to be deep crimson. Includes alternate color palettes such as Pink Delirium, Luddic Verdance, Cyan [REDACTED], and Violet Warpstorm. Users can switch themes by moving specific files into the graphics directory.
